notes: Partition verified: 23 source ids and 32 target ids each once.

s023 Χριστοῦ → even Christ: rule 105 settles only two carrier classes, an expressed preposition (fold) and a substantival article (added). The carrier here is a bare anarthrous noun, which neither arm reaches, so the fold stands as a rule 7 helper with the added reading named in the note — the right treatment of an unsettled carrier under rule 16.

s017/s018 split (εἰς → that, ἐπίγνωσιν → they may know) follows rule 61's principle that a preposition governing a nominalized construction takes the English clause-introducer; COL.2.22 reads the same construction the same way, which is rule 24's habit.
s003 and s015 are correctly unrepresented on different grounds — rule 20 displacement by αὐτῶν for the first, rule 23 absence of any determiner for the second.
